verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents its own per-environment flag control, unlimited environments, and RBAC that restricts who can modify production. It also documents running a full Flagsmith environment locally with Docker, which gives an isolated place to test outside production. The evidence does not, however, explicitly describe sandbox or staging environments as isolated from production data, or how an agent would target one. missing for 10: explicit documentation of environment-level data isolation from production, guidance on pointing agents (MCP/CLI) at a non-production environment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments
Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.
This guide explains how to run a full Flagsmith environment on your local machine using Docker.
